text: Debugging is an important skill for every programmer. When your code does not work as expected, the first step is identifying bugs by reading error messages carefully. Modern debugging tools, such as breakpoints and step-by-step execution, help you find where things go wrong. However, a systematic approach works best: test small parts of your code one at a time instead of guessing randomly. Adding logging to your program is also very useful, because it records what happens while the code runs. With patience and good habits, you can solve most problems and become a more confident developer.
